safety.disclaimer: This is a research prototype. Not medical advice. Discuss all decisions with your healthcare team.

glucoseLow.label: Low value
glucoseLow.title: Low value detected
glucoseLow.body: Your reading is below 70 mg/dL. If you feel unwell: take fast-acting carbohydrates (e.g. 15 g glucose tablets or 150 ml juice) and recheck in 15 minutes. If values stay low or you have confusion or loss of consciousness: seek medical help. This app does not replace medical advice.

glucoseHigh.label: High value
glucoseHigh.title: High value detected
glucoseHigh.body: Your reading is above 250 mg/dL. Watch for symptoms such as intense thirst, frequent urination, or nausea. Checking ketones may be useful. If values stay high or you feel unwell: please contact your healthcare provider. This app does not replace medical advice.

thesisInfoPage.title: About this study
thesisInfoPage.sectionResearchBody: This app was developed as part of a bachelor’s thesis at Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität Munich (LMU). The thesis examines how AI-supported features — in particular an empathetic chatbot, AI-supported logbook entries, and a mood–blood glucose correlation — can support emotional and metabolic self-management for people with diabetes.
thesisInfoPage.sectionEvalBody: As a study participant, you can explore the app freely. Your account already includes demo data so you can try all features right away. You are welcome to add your own entries and chat with Gluco. Afterwards, we ask you to complete a short questionnaire (about 10–15 minutes).
thesisInfoPage.sectionDataBody: All data are stored in pseudonymised form — we do not know your real name. At the latest after the study ends, all data will be deleted. Only anonymised, summarised results are included in the thesis. Individual histories will not be published.
thesisInfoPage.whoClosing: If you have questions about the study, the app, or privacy, you are welcome to email us at any time.

thesis.lead: GlucoCompanion is being developed as part of a bachelor’s thesis at the Institute of Informatics, Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität Munich (LMU).
thesis.p1: The thesis explores how AI-supported features (logbook, Gluco, insights) can support metabolic and emotional self-management in diabetes. The app is a research prototype — not a medical device and not a substitute for medical advice.
thesis.p2: Usage data are processed in pseudonymised form. Only anonymised, aggregated analyses are included in the written thesis; no real names, full chat histories, or attributable raw records are published.
thesis.p3: After the study and thesis are completed, all personal data are fully deleted as described in the privacy policy.
thesis.contactBody: For questions about data processing or participation, you can reach me at lilia@schraut.de.

buddy.title: Gluco
buddy.intro: Hey, I'm Gluco, your diabetes buddy. Here you can tell me how you're doing – I listen, ask questions, and help you better understand your diabetes experiences.
buddy.aiTransparencyNotice: You are talking to an AI chatbot (GPT-4o-mini). Replies are generated automatically and are not reviewed by a human. Gluco is not a therapist or a doctor. If you are in acute distress, please contact a professional counselling service.
buddy.suggestion1: I want to share a success
buddy.suggestion2: I feel overwhelmed by life with diabetes
buddy.defaultResponse: That's an interesting question. As a research prototype, I can't generate real AI answers yet, but in the finished version I would give you a helpful answer here. Is there anything else you'd like to discuss?
buddy.emotionalResponse: I hear that this is weighing on you. It's completely understandable to sometimes feel overwhelmed. Would you like to talk about what helps you in such moments?
buddy.dataResponse: It sounds like you mentioned data that I could suggest as a logbook entry. This feature is coming in a later version!

auth.consentIntro: This app is a research prototype developed as part of a bachelor’s thesis at Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität Munich. Before you begin, please take a moment to read the following:
auth.consentBodyDemo: Your account already includes realistic sample data (blood glucose, meals, insulin, mood) so you can try the app right away. This data is fictional and does not come from real people with diabetes.
auth.consentBodyYourData: If you create your own entries or chat with Gluco, those data are stored in pseudonymised form in a database (EU servers in Frankfurt). You will never be asked for your real name or personal contact details.
auth.consentBodyAI: The chatbot and text analysis use OpenAI (GPT-4o-mini). Your messages are sent to OpenAI servers in the United States for this purpose — without your pseudonym or user ID. There is a risk that US authorities could access this data.
auth.consentBodyProfiling: The app automatically analyses your text entries for mood and relates them to your blood glucose values. However, no automated decision with legal effect is made.
auth.consentBodyAge: Participation is intended only for people aged 18 and over.
auth.consentBodyNotMedical: This app does not replace medical or therapeutic advice. AI answers and AI-estimated values (e.g. carbohydrates) may be wrong or inaccurate and must not be used for medical decisions (e.g. insulin dosing).
auth.consentBodyVoluntary: Participation is voluntary and you may stop at any time. If you wish to have your data deleted, please email lilia@schraut.de — your data will then be deleted promptly.
auth.consentBodyDeletion: At the latest after the study ends and all questionnaires have been evaluated, all personal data will be fully deleted. Only anonymised, aggregated analyses are included in the bachelor’s thesis.
